name: albumen
description: Search and browse an Albumen library. The library stays read-only. Export and upload are off.
long_description: Albumen reads originals and leaves their bytes, names, and metadata as they are. This bundle asks for a library directory and starts the server against that directory. Search and browse are the tools. Export and upload stay off. There is no delete tool.

library.title: Library
library.description: Directory of originals. Albumen reads this directory and does not modify it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Read the library. Filter on path, capture date, camera, lens, GPS, keyword, and caption.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: List files under a relative prefix. Reads only.
